registryEntry.label: Quarterly Access Review of the CUI Group (owners review; no answer removes access)
registryEntry.set_command: Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/identityGovernance/accessReviews/definitions' -Body (@{displayName='CMMC-CUI-Group-Access-Review';descriptionForAdmins='CMMC PS.L2-3.9.2[c]: quarterly review of CUI group membership so access left over after a transfer is removed';scope=@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.accessReviewQueryScope';query='/groups/{cuiGroupId}/transitiveMembers';queryType='MicrosoftGraph'};reviewers=@(@{query='/groups/{cuiGroupId}/owners';queryType='MicrosoftGraph'});fallbackReviewers=@(@{query='/users/{operatorUserId}';queryType='MicrosoftGraph'});settings=@{mailNotificationsEnabled=$true;reminderNotificationsEnabled=$true;justificationRequiredOnApproval=$true;recommendationsEnabled=$true;instanceDurationInDays=14;defaultDecisionEnabled=$true;defaultDecision='Deny';autoApplyDecisionsEnabled=$true;recurrence=@{pattern=@{type='absoluteMonthly';interval=3};range=@{type='noEnd';startDate=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd')}}}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) -ContentType 'application/json' | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
